'''Rod Latham Abyssins Amok''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds10.htm Abyssins Amok], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319172618/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds10.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
